threads.body: The new contract is that `Timer` no longer exports a `.max` metric, but deleting the old positive assertion does not verify that behavior: this test would still pass if the gauge were accidentally restored because `waitAndAssertMetrics` only requires a matching metric for each supplied assertion. Add an explicit name-based emptiness assertion, as this test already does for `testTimer.histogram`.

replies.body: Addressed in 6be96fa9d331097bef25d141bd7768c38c8d8f42: Added explicit name-based emptiness assertions for the .max metric, mirroring the existing .histogram emptiness assertions, so the tests actively verify the gauge is no longer emitted.
